0022600174.text: The Washington Wizards (4-3, 2-1 at home, on a two-game winning streak, 1st in the Southeast and 6th in the East) host the Atlanta Hawks (4-4, 1-2 at home, on a one-game winning streak, 2nd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back, and 7th in the East) in the Wizards' eighth game of the 2026-27 season. The teams have no games yet this season, but the Wizards lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 126-96 loss in Atlanta on February 26, 2026. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins, Justin Champagnie, Reece Beekman and Tristan Vukcevic, and Alex Sarr, Anthony Gill and Bilal Coulibaly are day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar, Jock Landale and Mouhamed Gueye, with Jalen Johnson day-to-day and a game-time decision.
